facts.function: valve actuator and electronic engine controllers for industrial engine control

gri_path: GRI 1: candidates 8501 (electric motors/actuators), 8481 (valves), 9032 (automatic regulating or controlling apparatus); the heading depends on how the actuator works

rejected_alternatives.reason: fits the controllers (K89109) but not shown to fit the first-named valve actuator
applies if the actuator is a DC electric motor assembly (K89109, J81214); not established
applies if a self-contained valve; not established

missing_facts: Is the integrated valve actuator electric (DC motor, wattage), hydraulic or pneumatic, and is it combined with a valve body?
Do the controllers only perform the functions in Chapter 90 note 7 (digital, software-based)?
classify separately: APECS 500 Single Speed Electronic Engine Controller and APECS digital controllers
classification.rationale: K89109 shows actuators go to 8501.31 (DC motors) and controllers to 9032.89.60.85, but the description does not say what kind of actuator it is, so the first-named article's 6-digit subheading is a guess.
